row.evidence: Resource Guru's pricing page lists SSO (Single Sign-On) on Master and the help centre says "SSO is only available on the Master plan"; no SCIM is mentioned on the pricing page, help centre SSO articles or API reference.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none), now 'none by absence' at medium confidence: no page says SCIM is unavailable, but none mentions it. Price change since June: pricing cards now show Grasshopper $5, Blackbelt $8, Master $12 per person/mo billed annually ($6, $9.60, $14.40 monthly), up from June's $4.16 Grasshopper; the comparison-table header on the same page still carries the old $4.16 figure (see conflicts). June also said SSO needs 30+ users; no seat minimum for SSO was found on current pages, so that is dropped. SSO is SAML 2.0 with any IdP via a non-gallery/custom app; a 'self service' option lets anyone with the company email domain create their own login (JIT-like). The public REST API (OAuth2) and webhooks are on all plans; it can list users and create, update, delete and invite people (resources) but has no user deactivation endpoint.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Lists 'Enterprise API' and 'Audit export support'; what Enterprise API adds is not documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint or SCIM documentation found on the pricing page, help-centre SSO and integrations categories, or the OpenAPI reference.

auth.notes: Scope list beyond read/all is only partly read; users:read and resources:* follow the documented '<type>:read/write' pattern.

capabilities.notes: People are managed as 'resources'; creating a resource and inviting it gives the person a login. Users endpoints are read-only.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a resource; future bookings transferred or deleted
Invite an existing person to log in

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types include resources (people); event names per action not checked.

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per minute per registered application; 429 when exceeded.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/resource-guru/ returned 404; SAML works with Okta per Resource Guru help centre.

entra.notes: Help centre configures Entra as a non-gallery 'Create your own application' SAML app; no provisioning documented.

google.notes: Help centre has a Google Workspace SAML SSO guide (custom SAML app).

fallbacks.notes: JIT is the SSO 'Users Must Be Invited: No (self service)' option; 'SSO only' login blocks people removed from the IdP but does not remove their Resource Guru account.
